name: Newar
notes: Newar (Nepal Bhasa, नेपाल भाषा) of the Kathmandu Valley, ~850,000-1 million speakers, official language of the Kathmandu Metropolitan City and a recognised national language of Nepal; written today in Devanagari (historically also in the Ranjana and other Nepalese scripts). GRAPHEMES: the Devanagari letter-to-sound conventions are read the SAME way Hindi's spec already encodes them (`graphemes_base: hi`), following the `doi` precedent -- a claim about the shared script's reading convention, independent of Newar's own phonology (its tonal/phonation (breathy-voice) and vowel-length contrasts, quite unlike Nepali/Hindi, are declared directly in `phonemes` per Genetti 2007 and PHOIBLE). KNOWN GAP: Devanagari as currently used for Newar does not consistently write the breathy/murmured consonant series (b̤, d̤, ɡ̤, etc. in `phonemes`) with dedicated letters the way Hindi's own aspirated series is written -- Newar orthographic practice varies by writer/publisher on this, a genuine under-differentiation left undone rather than guessed. STRESS: no lexical stress contrast is described for Newar in Genetti (2007) (word-level prominence is not phonemically distinctive); left unencoded, a documented exemption. SMOKE CHECKS against `new_deva_narrow.tsv` (WikiPron, narrow transcription): अजा -> gold 'ə d͡ʑ a' (अ=ə via `hi`'s independent-vowel reading, ज=dʒ generalised narrowly to d͡ʑ in the gold's palatal-affricate convention, ा=a); अपा -> gold 'ə p a' (प=p, ा=a); अबु -> gold 'ə b u' (ब=b, ु=u) -- the inherited Hindi-style consonant/vowel-matra readings line up with the gold's segmentation; the narrow affricate symbol (d͡ʑ vs the inherited dʒ) and tone/phonation marks are the residual, expected narrow-transcription gap this spec does not yet close. TIER: `research` -- sourced (Genetti 2007; PHOIBLE), stress exemption documented, and `new_deva_narrow.tsv` (416 rows, WikiPron/Wiktionary scrape, `crowd-scraped` provenance, registered below) is scored in `scripts/benchmark.py` with a PER recorded in `benchmarks/results.json`.
